title: Second Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022
what_it_is: Second Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2022

sections.label: Supplementary Main Estimates heads
sections.summary: With no amendments, Heads of Expenditure are taken en bloc, starting with Heads C, L, P, T, U, V, W, X and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: As there are no amendments, I propose to take the Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: I will first take Heads C, L, P, T, U, V, W, X and Z of the Supplementary Main Estimates.
